cause_quote: The diff removed `if (props.inspectionError) { return renderRetryError(props.inspectionError, props.onRetryInspection); }` from `renderAccess`, so a failed inspection with no result fell through to the loading skeleton.
user_saw: The plugin’s Permissions section kept showing a loading skeleton after inspection failed, even though the error and Try again button were already visible.
summary: The fix ties the Permissions skeleton to the pending inspection request and suppresses the empty-settings message while permissions are unknown.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #142713 and confirmed that the existing Access section rendered the inspection error and retry before checking for missing data. The tab refactor moved the error to a shared banner and left the permissions views showing a skeleton whenever inspection data was missing. The grouped settings editor, #150235, and the Solid port carried that behavior forward.
